utts.text: welcome to the rusty anchor, traveler. what can i get you tonight?
the old bridge collapsed last winter, so you must take the mountain road.
i would not trust that merchant with a single copper coin.
keep your voice down. the guards are listening.
we need to find the key before the sun goes down.
roll for initiative! the goblins are charging from the trees.
does anyone have a healing potion? i am bleeding badly.
follow me, and stay close to the wall.
that door is locked. can somebody pick it?
i cast fireball at the center of the room.
the dragon has been sleeping under the mountain for a hundred years.
pay up, or you will regret it.
thank you, friend. i owe you my life.
who goes there? show yourself!
get out of my tavern before i call the city watch.
the treasure is hidden behind the waterfall.
i think we should rest here for the night.
run! the ceiling is falling!
my brother went into the forest three days ago and never came back.
how much for a room and a hot meal?
two gold pieces, and you clean up after your horse.
hold on. i hear something moving in the dark.
nobody leaves this room until i find out who stole my ring.
the king wants to see you in the morning.
be careful. the floor is covered in traps.
i am not afraid of you, little bird.
we could sneak in through the sewers tonight.
light the torch. i cannot see a thing.
help! somebody help me, please!
